en.summary: Configure and inspect Pages Git builds
details: Let Pages build and publish after a source push. Prepare the repository, deployment branch, root directory, build command, output directory and tool versions, and authorize GitHub repository access.
<name>: cloud project name; <patch>: absolute path to a JSON configuration patch.
swcl prepares CLI tools as needed. If authorization is missing, run swcl cloudflare/auth/setup. API Tokens need Cloudflare Pages edit access for the target account.
1. Connect Git and read current settings:

Run swcl cloudflare/auth/setup, select Git repositories, and follow the steps to install and authorize the GitHub App for the target repository. CLI sign-in or a Pages API Token does not replace repository access. The user selects repository access during web authorization; operate the web UI only when explicitly requested.

With Git access authorized, cf pages create can create a Git project through source fields. Wrangler pages project create creates Direct Upload projects. The CLI also exposes pages source connect, but this does not establish support for converting Direct Upload projects; the official guide requires a new Git project.
swcl cloudflare/cli schema pages create          #Show Git project creation fields
swcl cloudflare/cli schema pages source connect  #Show repository connection fields

Pass the prepared JSON with --body "@<patch>" and add --dry-run first to inspect the request. dry-run does not verify cloud Git access. Do not create a project or connect a repository just to check authorization.

Read an existing project source to check its repository and branch. A recent successful build confirms access at that time. Neither verifies authorization for a new repository. No general Pages authorized-repository listing command has been confirmed.
swcl cloudflare/cli pages get <name>                                         #Read project and build settings
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages deployment list --project-name <name> --json  #Read deployment records
cf and Wrangler have separate native logins; use the same target account for both. Remove credentials and sensitive environment settings before sharing query results.
Connection guide: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/get-started/git-integration/
2. Prepare build settings:
Commit the build script and verify a clean local build. Configure platform tool versions, build variables and private dependency access; check the command, version and output in the first build log.
Manage the Pages Git build command in platform project settings. Repository Wrangler configuration controls output and runtime bindings. Workers build.command does not apply to Pages Git builds.
Read current settings, then save only the intended changes to <patch>. This example assumes scripts/build.sh exists and writes output to dist:
{"build_config":{"root_dir":"","build_command":"sh scripts/build.sh","destination_dir":"dist"}}
Replace the example with project values. root_dir selects the repository subdirectory used for the build; an empty string selects the repository root.
3. Preview and apply the update:
swcl cloudflare/cli pages edit <name> --body "@<patch>" --dry-run  #Preview the update request
swcl cloudflare/cli pages edit <name> --body "@<patch>"            #Apply build settings
swcl cloudflare/cli pages get <name>                               #Check saved settings
--body @file avoids losing JSON quotes when PowerShell passes a string through .cmd. Check the account, project and fields in the --dry-run output, then apply the update.
Configure tool versions, build variables and secrets on the platform for production and preview. Wrangler runtime vars and Git build variables have different purposes; configure them separately.
4. Trigger a build and check deployment:
Trigger by pushing a new commit to the connected repository branch, creating or retrying a deployment with cf CLI, calling a Deploy Hook, or retrying in the dashboard.
swcl cloudflare/cli pages deployments create <name> --branch <branch>              #Build branch HEAD
swcl cloudflare/cli pages deployments retry <deployment-id> --project-name <name>  #Retry an existing deployment
create uses the selected branch HEAD, or the production branch when --branch is omitted. Use retry for an existing deployment, not to select the latest commit of a branch.

Create a Deploy Hook and select its branch under Pages project Settings → Builds → Add deploy hook. Store the URL in the local CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL environment variable and send HTTP POST. The URL grants trigger access; keep it out of repositories and logs.
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri $env:CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL  #Build the hook branch
cf builds deploy-hooks belongs to Workers Builds, not Pages. Pages deployments create needs no Deploy Hook.
Build trigger: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/pages/subresources/projects/subresources/deployments/methods/create/
Deploy Hooks: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/deploy-hooks/

Read build logs on failure. If no deployment appears, check GitHub access, branch controls and build path filters. After success, request the site and key assets to verify version and delivery headers.
swcl cloudflare/cli pages edit --help        #Show native update options
swcl cloudflare/cli schema pages edit        #Show request fields
swcl help/en cloudflare/deploy/pages-upload  #Read the output upload workflow
Build environment: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/build-image/
Build settings: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/build-configuration/
Wrangler configuration: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/functions/wrangler-configuration/

zh.summary: 配置并检查 Pages Git 托管构建
details: 让 Pages 在源码推送后构建和发布。先准备仓库、部署分支、根目录、构建命令、产物目录及工具版本，并授权 GitHub 应用访问仓库。
<name>：云端项目名；<patch>：配置补丁 JSON 文件的绝对路径。
CLI 工具由 swcl 按需准备；尚未授权时运行 swcl cloudflare/auth/setup。使用 Token 时，需要目标账号的 Cloudflare Pages 编辑权限。
1. 建立 Git 接入并读取现状：
运行 swcl cloudflare/auth/setup，选择“Git 仓库”，按指引完成 GitHub App 安装和用户授权，并允许访问目标仓库。CLI 登录或 Pages API Token 不能代替仓库授权。网页授权范围由用户选择；仅在用户明确要求时接管网页操作。
已有授权时，cf pages create 可通过 source 字段创建 Git 项目；Wrangler pages project create 创建 Direct Upload 项目。CLI 虽提供 pages source connect，但不能据此认定 Direct Upload 项目可转换；官方指南要求新建 Git 项目。
swcl cloudflare/cli schema pages create          #查看 Git 项目创建字段
swcl cloudflare/cli schema pages source connect  #查看已有项目的仓库绑定字段
用 --body "@<patch>" 提交准备好的 JSON；先加 --dry-run 检查请求。dry-run 不验证云端 Git 权限；不要为了检查授权而创建项目或执行绑定。
读取已有项目的 source 可核对仓库与分支，最近成功构建可证明当时拉取成功；这些信息不能代替新仓库的授权检查。尚未确认通用的 Pages 授权仓库列表命令。
swcl cloudflare/cli pages get <name>                                         #读取项目与构建设置
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages deployment list --project-name <name> --json  #读取部署记录
cf 和 Wrangler 的原生登录相互独立，操作时使用同一目标账号。分享查询结果前隐去其中的凭据和敏感环境配置。
接入流程：https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/get-started/git-integration/
2. 准备构建设置：
提交构建脚本并验证干净检出的本地构建。配置平台工具版本、构建变量及私有依赖权限，首次构建再核对日志中的命令、版本和产物。
Pages 的 Git 构建命令在平台项目设置中管理；仓库的 Wrangler 配置用于产物目录和运行时绑定。Workers 的 build.command 不适用于 Pages Git 构建。
先读取现有设置，再把本次变更保存到 <patch>。以下示例假定仓库已有 scripts/build.sh，输出到 dist：
{"build_config":{"root_dir":"","build_command":"sh scripts/build.sh","destination_dir":"dist"}}
用项目的实际值替换示例；root_dir 指平台执行构建的仓库子目录，空字符串表示仓库根目录。
3. 预览请求并应用配置：
swcl cloudflare/cli pages edit <name> --body "@<patch>" --dry-run  #预览更新请求
swcl cloudflare/cli pages edit <name> --body "@<patch>"            #应用构建设置
swcl cloudflare/cli pages get <name>                               #核对保存结果
--body @文件 可避免 PowerShell 经 .cmd 传递 JSON 字符串时丢失引号。核对 --dry-run 输出的账号、项目和字段后，执行更新。
在平台为生产和预览环境分别设置工具版本、构建变量和秘密。Wrangler 的运行时 vars 与 Git 构建变量用途不同，应分别配置。
4. 触发构建并检查发布：
触发方式：向已关联的仓库分支推送新提交、用 cf CLI 创建部署或重试已有部署、调用 Deploy Hook，或在控制台重试部署。
swcl cloudflare/cli pages deployments create <name> --branch <branch>              #构建分支最新提交
swcl cloudflare/cli pages deployments retry <deployment-id> --project-name <name>  #重试已有部署
create 的 --branch 使用该分支 HEAD；省略时使用项目生产分支。retry 用于已有部署，不作为选择分支最新提交的入口。
Deploy Hook：在 Pages 项目 Settings → Builds → Add deploy hook 中创建并选择分支。将 URL 放入本地环境变量 CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL 后发送 HTTP POST。URL 本身具有触发权限，不写入仓库或日志。
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri $env:CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL  #触发钩子对应分支的构建
cf builds deploy-hooks 属于 Workers Builds，不用于 Pages。Pages 可直接用 deployments create，无需先创建钩子。
构建触发：https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/pages/subresources/projects/subresources/deployments/methods/create/
部署钩子：https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/deploy-hooks/
失败时读取构建日志；没有部署记录时检查 GitHub 权限、分支控制和构建路径过滤。成功后请求站点及关键资源，确认版本和交付响应头。
swcl cloudflare/cli pages edit --help        #查看原生更新参数
swcl cloudflare/cli schema pages edit        #查看请求字段
swcl help/zh cloudflare/deploy/pages-upload  #查看产物上传方案
构建环境：https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/build-image/
构建设置：https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/build-configuration/
Wrangler 配置：https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/functions/wrangler-configuration/
